query: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
answer:
The first person to walk on the Moon was Neil Armstrong, the commander of NASA's Apollo 11 mission [1]. He stepped onto the surface on July 20, 1969, US time. In GMT that was 02:56 on July 21 [2]. Buzz Aldrin followed him about 19 minutes later. Michael Collins stayed in lunar orbit aboard the command module [2]. Armstrong died in August 2012 at age 82 [3].

[1] Apollo 11 People – Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum: https://airandspace.si.edu/amp-stories/neil-armstrong
